textarea

Multi-line text box. It is a native component. Pay attention to related restrictions when using it.Note: Currently, this attribute is implemented on the web and is not native. Therefore, some attributes are not supported.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
value String No Content in the input box.
placeholder String No Placeholder when the text box is empty.
placeholder-style String No Placeholder style. The options are color, font-size, and font-weight.
placeholder-class String textarea-placeholder No Style class of the placeholder.
disabled Boolean false No Disabled or not.
maxlength Number 140 No Maximum input length. The value -1 indicates that the maximum length is not limited.
focus Boolean false No Whether to obtain the focus.
auto-height Boolean false No Whether to automatically increase the height. When auto-height is set, style.height does not take effect.
cursor Number -1 No Cursor position of a focus. By default, it is at the end of a line.
selection-start Number -1 No Start position of the cursor. It is valid for automatic focus and needs to be used with selection-end.
selection-end Number -1 No End position of the cursor. It is valid for automatic focus and needs to be used with selection-start.
adjust-position Boolean true No Whether to automatically push the page when the keyboard pops up.
bindfocus eventHandle No Triggered when the text box is focused. The output is event.detail = {value}.
bindblur eventHandle No Triggered when the text box loses focus. The output is event.detail = {value}.
bindlinechange eventHandle No Used when the number of rows in the text box changes. The output is event.detail = {height: 0, heightRpx: 0, lineCount: 0}.
bindinput eventHandle No Whether to trigger the input event during keyboard input. The output is event.detail = {value, cursor}. The return value of bindinput is not reflected in the textarea.

Sample Code


<view class='textarea-wrp'>
  <textarea focus id='textarea2' selection-start='1' selection-end='3' style='height: 3em' value='自动聚焦' maxlength='10' auto-height />
</view>

Bug & Tip

  1. The blur event of the textarea is later than the tap event on the page. To obtain the textarea from the button click event, you need to use the bindsubmit attribute of the form.
  2. It is not recommended to modify user input on multiple lines of text, so the bindinput attribute of the textarea does not reflect the return value to the textarea.
  3. When cursor, selection-start, and selection-end coexist, selection-start and selection-end are used.
